يقترحون (form VIII)
# يَقْتَرِحُونَ (yaqtariḥūna) /jaq.ta.ri.ħuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
# يُقْتَرَحُونَ (yuqtaraḥūna) /juq.ta.ra.ħuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
